shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Interactive card hover state only. Never at rest.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, tooltips, scrolled-nav, modals. Structural depth only.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: All entrances and state transitions. Exponential ease-out — snaps in, doesn't linger.

motion.name: stagger-list
motion.purpose: Delay between staggered list items in a single entrance sequence.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA. Amber fill, near-white text. Used for the main conversion action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background-color: #ED9D18; color: #FCFBFC; font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #C8861A; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(14, 38, 70, 0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ED9D18; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navy Button
components.description: Secondary CTA. Navy fill. Used alongside primary amber button — never two amber buttons on the same screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-navy { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background-color: #0E2646; color: #FCFBFC; font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-navy:hover { background-color: #1a3a63; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-navy:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-navy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ED9D18; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary action. Transparent with navy border. Fills navy on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background-color: transparent; color: #0E2646; font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 13px 31px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #0E2646; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: #0E2646; color: #FCFBFC; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ED9D18; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input. Surface fill, navy border at rest, amber border on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #0E2646; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-input { font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: #0E2646; background-color: #F4F5F7; border: 1px solid rgba(14, 38, 70, 0.15); border-radius: 6px; padding: 11px 14px; width: 100%; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5A6780; } .ds-input:focus { border: 2px solid #ED9D18; padding: 10px 13px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Light Card
components.description: Content card on light-mode sections. Surface fill, no border at rest, hover lift.
components.html:
Gate & Door Automation

Heavy-duty slide, swing, and roll-up door motors configured for seamless remote access.
components.css: .ds-card-light { background-color: #F4F5F7; border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-card-light:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(14, 38, 70, 0.10); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0E2646; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0 0 10px 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: #5A6780; line-height: 1.65; margin: 0; }

components.name: Dark Card
components.description: Content card on navy section backgrounds. Subtle glass-like lift over navy.
components.html:
Smart Glass Tint

Switchable PDLC privacy glass — clear to frosted with a single tap.
components.css: .ds-card-dark { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-card-dark:hover { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); } .ds-card-dark-title { font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #FCFBFC; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0 0 10px 0; } .ds-card-dark-body { font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(252,251,252,0.70); line-height: 1.65; margin: 0; }

components.name: Amber Tag
components.description: Status badge or highlight label. Amber tint on light bg. Not a pill — 4px radius.
components.css: .ds-tag-amber { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.03em; background-color: rgba(237, 157, 24, 0.12); color: #8B5E00; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
CV Mechatronics installs systems that disappear into the fabric of a property — a gate that opens before you reach it, glass that clears at the touch of a button, cameras that watch without announcing themselves. The design system reflects this: authority without ostentation. Precision without coldness. The palette is amber and deep navy on a near-white field — the warmth of brushed hardware against a clean architectural canvas. Think Siemens's product catalog cross-referenced with a B&O showroom: functional inevitability, nothing gratuitous.

Typography is industrial and condensed at display scale — the narrow width reads like text stencilled on a steel panel, confident and non-decorative. Body copy opens to regular Barlow width for easy reading. Motion is choreographed at page load and scroll-triggered at the section level.

The navy #0E2646 anchors dark sections while the near-white #FCFBFC carries the light sections. Amber #ED9D18 is the signal color: CTAs, active states, key icons, and highlights. It appears rarely and counts every time.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy + amber on near-white — unexpected for the smart-home category, immediately distinctive
Condensed grotesque display + regular grotesque body — industrial precision, not editorial softness
Semi-sharp corners (8px cards, 6px buttons, 4px tags) — considered, not playful
Choreographed scroll entrances — motion serves the architecture of the page
Flat-by-default elevation — navy surfaces and amber accents create depth without shadows
Real photography required — actual gate, glass, and installation imagery

rules.name: The Amber Reserve Rule
rules.body: Amber is used on ≤15% of any given light-mode screen. It is the signal, not the noise. If a second element needs emphasis, use navy — not another amber element.

rules.name: The Text-on-Fills Rule
rules.body: Primary buttons (amber fill) use near-white text. Navy fills use near-white text. Never dark text on amber or navy fills.

rules.name: The Condensed-for-Impact Rule
rules.body: Condensed Barlow is reserved for H1 and H2 only. Using it for body copy, labels, or card titles flattens the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Letter-Spacing Floor Rule
rules.body: Display letter-spacing never goes below -0.02em. At clamp maximums on wide viewports, -0.03em is the floor.

rules.name: The No-Rest-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No surface carries a shadow at its resting state. Shadows are a response to interaction (hover, focus, elevation) — not decoration.

rules.name: The One-Treatment Rule
rules.body: A border and a shadow are not combined on the same element at the same time. Pick one or neither.

dos: Do use amber (#ED9D18) sparingly — one primary CTA, one key accent per screen.
Do alternate light (paper) and dark (navy) section backgrounds for rhythm.
Do use Barlow Condensed in uppercase at display sizes.
Do keep border-radius at 8px for cards, 6px for buttons, 4px for tags.
Do use real photography of actual gate, smart glass, and lighting installations.
Do apply text-wrap: balance on H1–H3 and test heading overflow at every breakpoint.
Do keep body text (#0E2646) at ≥4.5:1 on light sections, near-white on navy sections.
donts: Don't use the dark glassmorphism + cyan-glow aesthetic from the reference landing page.
Don't use warm beige/cream as the page background. #FCFBFC is near-white, not warm neutral.
Don't place two amber elements in the same view competing for attention.
Don't add box-shadow to cards at resting state.
Don't pair a 1px border with a large drop shadow (blur ≥ 16px) on the same element.
Don't use border-radius above 12px on any card or section container.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Amber is a solid color.
Don't add a small uppercase eyebrow label above every section heading.
Don't use numbered markers (01/02/03) above sections unless the section is an ordered sequence.
Don't use Barlow Condensed for body copy, labels, or UI text.
